items.title: French Pastries
items.creator: SandBlock Studios
items.description:
Enter a French bakery, meet the Head Chef, be real cooker and craft 24 pastries and bread and 4 powerful weapons using custom machines for your new survival world. Use food with special effects to heal, boost, or fight in style.
• Custom items and recipes
• Interactive machines
• 6 exclusive skins
This item uses random start areas for any new world. Endless possibilities!

items.title: Askew: Audio Overhaul
items.creator: Syclone Studios
items.description:
Play for the first time AGAIN with this groundbreaking AUDIO OVERHAUL pack with everything just a little... different. 

+ Over 5 hours of original music and reimagined sounds for everything
+ Strange 14x14 textures
+ Custom mob variants
+ Real-time seasons
+ Hand-crafted blocks, retooled items, and so much more!
+ From Syclone Studios
items.changelog:
+5 new songs!
+3 Updated songs!
+New /playsound support!
+New & Updated sounds!
+Colored Lighting! and other Vibrant Visuals tweaks!
+Hundreds of Mob & Block retextures!
+Multiple bug fixes!
+Updated for Mounts of Mayhem, Tiny Takeover, and Chaos Cubed!

items.title: Mall Luxury
items.creator: Eescal Studios
items.description:
Welcome to the most luxurious mall in the world, featuring elegant, detailed interiors!
- Explore a wide variety of attractions, including an underground aquarium, an arcade playroom, and banner shops!
- Surrounded by nearby apartment buildings and breathtaking mountain views!
- Awesome for survival and roleplay. Don't forget to invite your friends!

items.title: Structures Add-On 2.0
items.creator: Teplight
items.description:
Structure generation in an Add-On! You will LOVE it! Encounter:
- Over 110 structures.
- Dungeons and loot.
- Structures in almost every biome!
- 90+ custom blocks with advanced gameplay and variations.
- Vanilla based custom block functionality.
Add this Add-On to your world today!
items.changelog:
Structures Add-On 2.0: The Nether Update!
- New structures generating throughout the Nether, including the Crimson Forest and Soul Sand Valley
- New Custom Nether themed blocks and statues

Structures have invaded the Nether, jump in and explore today!

items.title: Escape the Toy Factory
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Crawl through the creepy rooms of the Toy Factory and escape with the toy you came for!

- Unique puzzles and mechanics
- Boss fights
- Immersive atmosphere
- 3 toy skins

By Imaginary Trident Studios and Pathway Studios

items.title: Beyond The End 1.2 Add-On
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Explore 'Beyond the End', the Add-On that radically transforms the End in Minecraft:

+Discover 6 enchanting new biomes
+Explore a redesigned central island
+Encounter new mobs, and uncover new blocks and items
+Experience exclusive mechanics and features +Investigate new ores, weapons and armor
items.changelog:
1.2 update is here!
- Addition of translations in 28 languages
- Improvements to the tutorial book and settings tool
- Bug fixes and optimization

items.title: Evil Emoji
items.creator: Cleverlike
items.description:
Unleash a wave of horror with Evil Emojis!
This scary skin pack reimagines familiar faces as terrifying monsters.
Delve into this chilling repo of ghoulish grins and demonic expressions.
Perfect for adding a spooky twist to your amazing adventures.
Frighten your friends and embrace the darkness!

items.title: Ultimate Survival Village
items.creator: Fun Creators
items.description:
Step into the ultimate survival experience with this stunning world! Explore a scenic mountain-side village where every villager profession has a custom home! Perfect for trading, exploring, and thriving with friends!

- Majestic medieval village
- 2 vanilla villages (one hidden in epic mountains!)
- Unique houses for all villager professions
- Multiplayer survival spawn

items.title: Medieval Village
items.creator: Fun Creators
items.description:
Unleash your adventure in this epic survival world featuring a colossal statue and a beautifully decorated village! Every house is packed with detail and charm, making it the perfect place to start your journey. Explore, build, and thrive in style!

- Massive custom statue
- Highly decorated medieval houses
- Unique village full of life
- Multiplayer survival spawn

items.title: Fire Clan
items.creator: Time Trap Studios
items.description:
Fight your way through fiery battles with this powerful clan! With these colorful purple flames, soulfire heat, and green nova will be sure to torch all your enemies. 
- 28 Fire Clan Skins!
- 1 free skin
- By Time Trap Studios

items.title: Soul Warriors
items.creator: Glowfischdesigns
items.description:
Soul Warriors are forged in battle and bound by spirit.
Ancient energy surges through their veins, glowing beneath armor cracked by the sheer force of their soul.
Their eyes burn with purpose, their movements echo with power.
They rise from the ashes of conflict, ready to strike with unrelenting force.

+ 8 Skins

items.title: BE a MOB Add-On
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description: [1.21 Update] More than a MORPH! With this incredible Add-On, you can Be a Mob in your world! New game mechanics, incredible abilities, Custom UI system! and MUCH more awaits you on this masterpiece, the next generation is here! What are you waiting for?

items.title: Enchantment Expansion
items.creator: King Cube
items.description: Enchants? Experience 60+ new enchantments with Enchantment Expansion Add-On
items.changelog:
Changes in New Update:
- Added 25x new enchantments!
- Added better Add-On support!
- New Enchantable Types: Spears, Elytra, Trident and more!
- Improved lots of enchantments!
- Fixed various bugs!

items.title: WEAPONS OP!
items.creator: Chillcraft
items.description:
Craft 20 insanely powerful weapons and dominate the battlefield! Blast enemies with TNT, freeze them with ice, or poison them with a single strike. Summon Allays, strike with lightning, and unleash chaos like never before. 

+ 20+ Craftable weapons
+ Custom animations
+ Multiplayer friendly!

This item uses random start areas for any new world. Endless possibilities!

items.title: LAFD Firefighter Heroes
items.creator: Logdotzip
items.description: Fight fire with firefighters! Douse yourself in these special edition Firefighter skins by Logdotzip, officially in partnership with the Los Angeles Fire Department Foundation. Proceeds from the pack will go to LAFD’s mission to fund equipment and programs that help LAFD firefighters keep the community safe.

items.title: Display Stuff Add-On
items.creator: Blockception
items.description:
Turn your house into a home! Display Stuff lets you add charm and detail to any build. Perfect for roleplay and decorating!

+ Place items naturally around your world
+ Stack items into decorative piles
+ Craft cozy pillows, sleek cabinets, and more

items.title: Ninja Empire
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Step into Ninja Empire, a vast world of ninjas and warriors.

Explore a massive +1000x1000 world. Fight in the dojo, build your base and rule the land in this epic adventure!

=>Train like a true ninja
=>Anime style textures
=>Unique build theme
=>Perfect for role-play and multiplayer
=>Temples, statues, structures and more
=>Epic weapons and armor textures
=>8 free skins

items.title: City Apocalypse
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Oh no! A massive eruption has left the city of Mineland in ruin! Can you survive this new environment?

+ Massive apocalypse city!
+ Detailed buildings to explore!

items.title: Animal Pajamas
items.creator: Entity Builds
items.description: Get cozy and wild with the Animal Pajamas skin pack! Dress up as your favorite cuddly creatures—from bouncy bunnies to roaring dragons. These fun, fluffy skins are perfect for sleepovers, adventures, and exciting roleplay. Show off your wild side in the cutest way possible—pajama style!

items.title: Nightmares
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description:
Enter a world of darkness with this terrifying skin pack. Featuring 12 scary designs inspired by nightmares, monsters, and horror itself.
These skins are perfect for anyone who dares to embrace the dark shadows.

+ 12 Scary Monster Skins
+ By MobBlocks

items.title: TOILETS
items.creator: Ambient Creations
items.description: Fun, quirky, and different! Indulge in your weird side and choose from 5 toilet skins.

items.title: Ghosts Add-On
items.creator: Piki Studios
items.description:
Are you ready to be scared? That’s right—every creature now has a ghost, and they’re coming for you! Don’t worry, you can protect yourself, but you can’t touch them! Join the adventure now!

- 70+ Mobs' Ghost Version!
- Ectoplasm and Silver Items and Blocks!
- Silver Ruins as structures!
- Funnier with friends!
- By Piki Studios

items.title: Chomp Add-On
items.creator: The World Foundry
items.description: Have you ever wondered why all that space up in your face isn't being put to better use? No? Well, never mind: Chomp Add-On takes care of that problem. With this Add-On you can extract and replace Teeth, craft Chatters, enhance Iron Swords, and make Spiked Carpet traps! There's loads of new content and a great new mechanic.

items.title: Mythic Mobs
items.creator: SystemZee's Workshop
items.description:
Three mythical mobs have invaded your world with this Add-On!

Dodge the powerful Cavern Brawler and uncover ancient ores!
Outsmart The Snatchling thief in a memory game and unlock interesting rewards!
Soar through the sky with The Stormspitter, a living cannon enraged with lightning!

Unlock epic armor, tools, and more with Mythic Mobs!
items.changelog:
Make way for an expansion! The mythic mobs are back, better than ever!

- A rework of the Cavern Brawler, with a new look! 
- More rewards for The Snatchling!
- A faster and smarter Stormspitter!
- New blocks, new items, and a better gameplay experience!
